subject.title: [Bug]: 6.x state migration leaves channel conversation-store SQLite empty (0 bytes) — orphans references, breaks proactive (Bot Framework) sends (MS Teams)

question: Should maintainers land the narrow archive-visibility guard in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98862 now, or require packaged upgrade proof or broader recovery first?
rationale: The linked PR is small and directly targets the issue, but persisted migration archive behavior determines whether recoverable conversation data is retained during upgrades.

options.title: Land The Narrow Guard
options.body: Accept PR 98862 as the immediate fix for the zero-visible-row migration failure and track already-archived recovery separately if needed.

options.title: Require Upgrade Transcript
options.body: Ask for a redacted packaged upgrade or doctor transcript before accepting the migration behavior change.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Hold the PR until it also handles already archived sources or partial-import recovery.

recommendation.title: Land The Narrow Guard
recommendation.body: Accept PR 98862 as the immediate fix for the zero-visible-row migration failure and track already-archived recovery separately if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the central MS Teams SQLite store and doctor migration history for this archive behavior decision.
